name: Nucleus XR Training Platform
summary:
Nucleus XR is an enterprise-grade extended reality (XR) training platform designed to help organizations deploy, manage, and scale immersive training experiences with confidence. Built for industries where safety, precision, and consistency matter, Nucleus XR combines powerful content management, real-time analytics, and flexible deployment into a single, cohesive system.
